Name: Blades in the Dark

CrewTypes.Name: Assassins
CrewTypes.Hook: You're professional murderers—death is your business.
CrewTypes.Description: Assassins use murder, intimidation, and targeted violence to maintain control of their operations and earn coin.
CrewTypes.ExperienceTrigger: Execute a successful murder, ransom, or assassination operation.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Deadly
SpecialAbilities.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Hunt, Prowl, or Skirmish (up to a max rating of 3).

SpecialAbilities.Name: Crow's Veil
SpecialAbilities.Description: Due to hard-won experience or occult ritual, your activities are hidden from the notice of the death-seeker crows. You don't take extra heat when killing is involved on a score.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Emberdeath
SpecialAbilities.Description: You know the arcane method to destroy a living victim's spirit at the moment you kill them. Take 3 stress to channel electroplasmic energy from the ghost field to disintegrate the spirit and the dead body in a shower of sparking embers.

SpecialAbilities.Name: No Traces
SpecialAbilities.Description: When you keep an operation quiet or make it look like an accident, you get half the rep value of the target (round up) instead of zero. When you end downtime with zero heat, take +1 rep.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Patron
SpecialAbilities.Description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Predators
SpecialAbilities.Description: When you use stealth or subterfuge to commit murder, take +1d to the engagement roll.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Vipers
SpecialAbilities.Description: When you acquire or craft poisons, you get +1 result level to your roll. When you employ a poison, you are specially prepared to be immune to its effects.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Veteran
SpecialAbilities.Description: Choose a special ability from another crew.

Upgrades.Name: Cohort (Gang or Expert)
Upgrades.Description: A cohort is a gang or a single expert NPC who works for your crew.

Upgrades.Name: Training
Upgrades.Description: Legacy unspecified-track training. Retained for saved crews; choose a named training track for new upgrades.

Upgrades.Name: Insight Training
Upgrades.Description: Training Insight during downtime grants 2 xp instead of 1.

Upgrades.Name: Prowess Training
Upgrades.Description: Training Prowess during downtime grants 2 xp instead of 1.

Upgrades.Name: Resolve Training
Upgrades.Description: Training Resolve during downtime grants 2 xp instead of 1.

Upgrades.Name: Playbook Training
Upgrades.Description: Training playbook xp during downtime grants 2 xp instead of 1.

Upgrades.Name: Boat House
Upgrades.Description: A boat, dock, and supply shack. The second box adds armor and cargo capacity.

Upgrades.Name: Carriage House
Upgrades.Description: A carriage, draft animals, and stable. The second box adds armor and larger, swifter draft animals.

Upgrades.Name: Secure Lair
Upgrades.Description: Your lair has locks, alarms, and traps to thwart intruders. A second upgrade improves the defenses to include arcane measures.

Upgrades.Name: Hidden Lair
Upgrades.Description: Your lair has a secret location and is disguised to hide it from view.

Upgrades.Name: Vault
Upgrades.Description: Your lair has a secure vault, increasing your storage capacity for coin to 8. A second upgrade increases your capacity to 16.

Upgrades.Name: Quarters
Upgrades.Description: Your lair includes living quarters for the crew.

Upgrades.Name: Workshop
Upgrades.Description: Your lair has a workshop appointed with tools for tinkering and alchemy.

Upgrades.Name: Quality: Weapons
Upgrades.Description: Each upgrade improves the quality rating of all the PCs' weapons.

Upgrades.Name: Mastery
Upgrades.Description: Your crew has access to master level training. You may advance your PCs' action ratings to 4.

Upgrades.Name: Hardened
Upgrades.Description: Each PC gets +1 trauma box.

Upgrades.Name: Composed
Upgrades.Description: Legacy generic +1 stress box upgrade, retained so saved crews keep loading; the Assassins sheet lists no stress upgrade.

Upgrades.Name: Assassin rigging
Upgrades.Description: Two free load of weapons or gear.

Upgrades.Name: Ironhook Contacts
Upgrades.Description: Your crew's Tier is effectively +1 higher in prison. This applies to any Tier-related element in prison, including the incarceration roll.

Upgrades.Name: Elite Skulks
Upgrades.Description: Your Skulks cohorts are elite: +1d when they roll for that type.

Upgrades.Name: Elite Thugs
Upgrades.Description: Your Thugs cohorts are elite: +1d when they roll for that type.

CrewTypes.Name: Cult
CrewTypes.Hook: You're devoted to a strange power—occult secrets and forbidden rituals are your trade.
CrewTypes.Description: Cultists use occult rituals, dark blessings, and supernatural threats to advance their esoteric agenda.
CrewTypes.ExperienceTrigger: Execute a successful operation involving consecration, sacrifice, or occult power.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Chosen
SpecialAbilities.Description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Attune, Study, or Sway (up to a max rating of 3).

SpecialAbilities.Name: Anointed
SpecialAbilities.Description: You gain +1d to resistance rolls against supernatural threats. You get +1d to healing rolls when you have supernatural harm.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Bound in Darkness
SpecialAbilities.Description: You may use teamwork with any cult member, regardless of the distance separating you. By taking 1 stress, your whispered message is heard by every cultist.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Conviction
SpecialAbilities.Description: Each PC gains an additional Vice: Worship. When you indulge this vice and bring a pleasing sacrifice, you don't overindulge if you clear excess stress. In addition, your deity will assist any one action roll you make, from now until you indulge this vice again.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Glory Incarnate
SpecialAbilities.Description: Your deity sometimes manifests in the physical world. This can be a great boon, but the priorities and values of a god are not those of mortals.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Sealed in Blood
SpecialAbilities.Description: Each human sacrifice yields -3 stress cost for any ritual you perform.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Zealotry
SpecialAbilities.Description: Your cohorts have abandoned their reason to devote themselves to the cult. They will undertake any service, no matter how dangerous or strange. They gain +1d to rolls against enemies of the faith.

CrewTypes.Hook: You're dealers in vice—pleasure and addiction are your stock in trade.
CrewTypes.Description: Hawkers sell contraband, vices, and illicit goods to the citizens of the city, using social connections and product quality to build their empire.
CrewTypes.ExperienceTrigger: Execute a successful operation involving product supply, sale, or acquisition of new clients or contraband sources.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Accord
SpecialAbilities.Description: Sometimes friends are as good as territory. You may count up to three +3 faction statuses you hold as if they are turf.

SpecialAbilities.Name: The Good Stuff
SpecialAbilities.Description: Your merchandise is exquisite. The product quality is equal to your Tier+2. When you deal with a crew or faction, the GM will tell you who among them is hooked on your product.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Ghost Market
SpecialAbilities.Description: Through arcane ritual or hard-won experience, you have discovered how to prepare your product for sale to ghosts and/or demons. They do not pay in coin.

SpecialAbilities.Name: High Society
SpecialAbilities.Description: It's all about who you know. Take -1 heat during downtime and +1d to gather information about the city's elite.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Hooked
SpecialAbilities.Description: Your gang members use your product. Add the savage, unreliable, or wild flaw to your gangs to give them +1 quality.

SpecialAbilities.Name: Synchronized

CohortEdges.Name: Fearsome
CohortEdges.Description: The cohort is terrifying in aspect and reputation.

CohortEdges.Name: Independent
CohortEdges.Description: The cohort can be trusted to make good decisions and act on their own initiative in the absence of direct orders.

CohortEdges.Name: Loyal
CohortEdges.Description: The cohort can’t be bribed or turned against you.

CohortEdges.Name: Tenacious
CohortEdges.Description: The cohort won’t be deterred from a task.

CohortFlaws.Name: Principled
CohortFlaws.Description: The cohort has an ethic or values that it won’t betray.

CohortFlaws.Name: Savage
CohortFlaws.Description: The cohort is excessively violent and cruel.

CohortFlaws.Name: Unreliable
CohortFlaws.Description: The cohort isn’t always available, due to other obligations, stupefaction from their vices, etc.

CohortFlaws.Name: Wild
CohortFlaws.Description: The cohort is drunken, debauched, and loud-mouthed.
